text:
lisa (Partnerships): Quick kickoff - vendor publisher portal setup for AWS/GCP/Azure. Goal: get accounts, legal ok, and packaging checklist done for the June marketplace sprint. target launch 2024-06-14.
emma (Product): Adding cadence: can we lock SKU/pricing model by EOD Tue? Need trial vs paid SKU mapping.
raj (Legal): I can review EULA, but we need to confirm whether marketplaces want our standard SaaS T&Cs or a marketplace-specific EULA (some require additional indemnities). Any custom clauses expected?
lisa (Partnerships): AWS asked for marketplace-specific EULA for some customers; Azure usually accepts standard with publisher attachments. I'll surface customer asks.
ben (Eng): On the infra side: do we publish an AMI (for on-prem/bring-your-own-cloud) or container registry image + terraform module? Both are possible but AMI will need hardened build and extra scanning.
emma (Product): Preference is container image + marketplace listing that references a deployment template (ARM/CloudFormation/Terraform). Only offer AMI if a major customer requests it.
ben (Eng): OK. I'll prepare a container-based deployment artifact and a minimal terraform example. Will need publisher account creds for automated publish.
marketplace-bot: Preflight results: logo dimensions OK, screenshots missing for GCP, pricing field blank, contact email missing.
lisa (Partnerships): Thanks bot. Action items: (1) raj: EULA variant by Thu, (2) ben: publishable container + terraform example by Fri, (3) emma: SKU/pricing mapping by Tue EOD, (4) me: publisher accounts + partner POC emails.
raj (Legal): Noted. Two questions: do we plan to include telemetry/usage reporting in the listing? That affects privacy clause and data processing addendum.
emma (Product): Yes minimal usage metrics for billing and health. Need to confirm anonymization and opt-out. I'll draft the telemetry description.
ben (Eng): For the terraform example, snippet below is the minimal provider block we plan to include. Please sanity-check before I commit to the manifest:
```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = "us-west-2"
}
module "redwood_marketplace" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-deploy"
  sku = "redwood-core-small"
}
```
lisa (Partnerships): Looks good. Also need asset checklist for publisher portal: logo PNG 600x200, 2 screenshots, short + long descriptions, pricing tiers, trial length, contact email, security whitepaper, support SLAs, publisher account ID, and publisher IAM role for automated publish.
marketplace-bot: Checklist status: missing screenshots (GCP), missing pricing, missing publisher-role ARN.
raj (Legal): Please add a checkbox for audit/contact for security customers. We'll need SOC2/HIPAA notes if flagged.
emma (Product): On pricing: proposing freemium trial 14 days + usage-based for tokens/embeddings and a flat monthly reserved seat for Dedicated. Will model examples and submit numbers.
ben (Eng): For automated publish we'll need a publisher IAM role with sts:AssumeRole and s3:PutObject permissions. Can someone from infra create that, or partnerships can ask customer?
lisa (Partnerships): I'll create publisher roles for our own Redwood publisher accounts, and for partner/customer-owned accounts we'll request the role template. I'll draft the exact policy and post it.
emma (Product): Timeline check: if legal signs off Thu and eng artifacts ready Fri, we can submit to publisher portals next week and expect 7-10 business days for approval. Is that OK?
raj (Legal): That's fine. I'll flag any problematic clauses early.
lisa (Partnerships): OK team - I'll follow up with a small doc and the publisher-role IAM policy in #partnerships later today. Please update the checklist in the doc when you complete your items. :thumbsup:
